questions.text:
Consider a relation [latex]R( A, B, C, D, E )[/latex] with the following three functional dependencies.
[latex]AB \rightarrow C;BC \rightarrow D; C \rightarrow E;[/latex]
The number of superkeys in the relation [latex]R[/latex] is .
questions.solution:
A and B never appear on the right side of any FD, so every key must contain A and B.
[latex]AB^+=AB\rightarrow ABC\rightarrow ABCD\rightarrow ABCDE[/latex], so AB is the only candidate key.

Superkeys = AB plus any subset of {C, D, E}: [latex]2^3=8[/latex].

Answer: 8

questions.text: The number of arrangements of six identical balls in three identical bins is ____.
questions.solution:
Balls and bins are both identical, so we count partitions of 6 into at most 3 parts:
6, 5+1, 4+2, 3+3, 4+1+1, 3+2+1, 2+2+2

Answer: 7

questions.text: A cache memory that has a hit rate of 0.8 has an access latency 10 ns and miss penalty 100 ns. An optimization is done on the cache to reduce the miss rate. However, the optimization results in an increase of cache access latency to 15 ns, whereas the miss penalty is not affected. The minimum hit rate (rounded off to two decimal places) needed after the optimization such that it should not increase the average memory access time is _____.
questions.solution:
Average memory access time = hit latency + miss rate [latex]\times[/latex] miss penalty.

Before: [latex]10+0.2\times100=30[/latex] ns.
After: [latex]15+(1-h)\times100\le30\Rightarrow1-h\le0.15\Rightarrow h\ge0.85[/latex]

Answer: 0.85

questions.text:
The value of the following limit is _____
[latex] \lim_{x \to 0+} \frac{ \sqrt{x}}{1-e^{2 \sqrt{x}}}[/latex]
questions.solution:
Let [latex]t=\sqrt x\to0^+[/latex]: the limit is [latex]\lim_{t\to0}\frac{t}{1-e^{2t}}[/latex] (form 0/0).

Since [latex]e^{2t}\approx1+2t[/latex]: [latex]\frac{t}{1-e^{2t}}\approx\frac{t}{-2t}=-\frac12[/latex] (same by L'Hospital: [latex]\frac{1}{-2e^{2t}}\to-\frac12[/latex]).

Answer: -0.5

questions.text: Consider the resolution of the domain name [latex]www.gate.org.in[/latex] by a DNS resolver. Assume that no resource records are cached anywhere across the DNS servers and that iterative query mechanism is used in the resolution. The number of DNS query-response pairs involved in completely resolving the domain name is .
questions.solution:
With iterative resolution and empty caches, the resolver asks each level in turn:
1. Root server [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] refers to the .in server
2. .in server [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] refers to org.in
3. org.in server [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] refers to gate.org.in
4. gate.org.in server [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] returns the IP of www.gate.org.in

Answer: 4
